en: Black‑and‑white illustrated view of a two‑story house with a small pediment and balcony, likely a café or restaurant with a garden terrace. In the foreground, many people sit at outdoor tables under leafy trees, drinking and talking; a server in an apron stands on the steps leading up to the entrance. The right part of the card is left blank, apparently for writing or printing. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century European café‑garden scene.
